messages:
anya: quick check — we're planning a microbatch rollup tonight 01:00 UTC. need owners for throughput window + a short profiling checklist. can ppl ack? :eyes:
liam: i'm on throughput owner. will run the dirbench and small-window runs. what's the target qps we want to hit for the smoke?
anya: thanks liam. target is 1.2x current baseline (baseline = 1800 qps for small-batch workload), so aim for ~2200 qps with <5% p99 regression.
sanjay: i'll take profiling + max-tokens regression. i'll validate KV cache warmup and dump perf counters. planning to gather gperftools and nvprof snapshots.
ops-bot: reminder: rolling job scheduled to start at 2632104000 (01:00 UTC). alert policy 'cb-rollup' will be enabled. react with :thumbsup: to confirm.
marie: quick question — are we changing max_batch_size or only batch window? last change we did both and hit a CPU spike.
liam: for this run just adjusting queue-window to 6ms -> 4ms and lowering soft cap from 256 -> 192. not touching max_batch_size. want to see queue backlog drop.
chen: adding one ask: please capture a sample of ~200 request traces (incl. token counts) and post to /tmp/microbatch-rollup/traces.tar.gz. I'll run the tail-latency regression script.
anya: SGTM. liam can you kick off the loadgen with the following config?
liam: yup. using this loadgen command:

```
./loadgen --profile small-batch --qps 2200 --duration 600 --warmup 60 --output results/microbatch-rollup
```

liam: also setting env `CB_QUEUE_WINDOW_MS=4` and `CB_SOFT_CAP=192` on the nodes.
sanjay: notes for profiling checklist: 1) capture KV hit/miss rates 2) collect per-shard GPU util + SM metrics 3) dump runtime histogram for enqueue/dequeue times 4) save a mini heap profile if we see CPU stalls.
marie: I'll watch infra dashboards and throttle if CPU > 75% across p99 hosts. ops-bot if anything breaches, please post the host list.
ops-bot: alert policy active. will post host list on breach.
liam: starting preflight in 10m. will post run link and short rollup summary when done.
anya: perfect — last thing: if we see >5% p99 regression roll back queue-window and soft cap to previous values and open a quick PR referencing this thread. thanks everyone. :rocket:
